desc: Implement a solution that reads $N$ and the array $A$.
Define the conditions for the left and right boundaries using prefix sums: $B[j] = P[j+1] + A[j]$ and $D[j] = P[j] - A[j]$.
Implement a Segment Tree to find the largest index $j < i$ such that $B[j] \ge P[i+1]$.
Implement a Segment Tree to find the smallest index $j > i$ such that $D[j] \le P[i]$.
Integrate these Segment Tree queries into the main loop to compute $L_{reach}[i]$ and $R_{reach}[i]$ for all $i$.
Calculate the final answer for each $i$ using the prefix sum array: $Ans[i] = P[R_{reach}[i]+1] - P[L_{reach}[i]]$.
